description: Download a student's document (PDF). documentId is the url field returned by ic_list_documents. On a hosted server it returns a signed, expiring download link (give it only to the user) — nothing is written to the server disk. On a local install it writes to destinationPath inside the download directory (IC_DOWNLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads) and will not overwrite an existing file unless overwrite is true. inline:true returns the file in the result instead (up to 10 MiB). Returns FeatureDisabled if the district has the module turned off.

destinationPath.description: Local install: where to write the PDF (required unless inline is true). Must be inside the download directory (IC_DOWNLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads); a relative path resolves against it. On a hosted server nothing is written to disk and only its file name is used, to name the download link.

documentId.description: The url field returned by ic_list_documents

inline.description: Return the document in the result as an embedded file (up to 10 MiB) instead of saving it or linking to it. Larger documents come back as a download link when hosted.

name: ic_download_document
